title: 云原生可观测性与 AI 基础设施：从开发者实践到全栈效率
english: Recent industry updates highlight two complementary directions for senior operations and development engineers. CNCF emphasizes that developers are increasingly expected to shift observability left, making monitoring and diagnostic practices part of development work. OpenAI describes abundant intelligence as the result of compounding advances across chips, compute, models, and products, with the goal of delivering useful intelligence at greater scale and lower cost. Its Jalapeño announcement focuses on faster, more power-efficient inference, higher throughput, and lower latency for modern models. Together, these themes connect software observability with AI infrastructure efficiency: teams need visibility into code and systems while also managing the performance, cost, and operational controls of AI workloads.
chinese: CNCF 的文章指出，开发者正被要求将可观测性左移，把监控与诊断纳入开发过程。OpenAI 则强调，芯片、算力、模型和产品等环节的进步会共同提升智能服务的规模与成本效率；其 Jalapeño 相关信息聚焦于更快、更节能的推理，以及更高吞吐量和更低延迟。对资深运维开发而言，这意味着云原生工程需要同时关注代码可观测性、AI 推理基础设施效率，以及工作区使用、成员权限和额度等管理能力。
why_it_matters: 可观测性左移直接关联云原生开发和 AIOps；推理吞吐、延迟与能耗是 Agent Infra 的核心工程指标；权限、额度和使用分析则关系到企业 AI 平台治理。掌握这些交叉能力，有助于运维开发人员从基础设施维护扩展到 AI 平台工程与可靠性建设。
interview_expression: I see observability and AI infrastructure efficiency as connected engineering responsibilities. In addition to monitoring system behavior, I would track inference latency, throughput, power efficiency, and operational controls such as permissions and usage limits.

vocabulary.meaning: 左移，将质量、测试或可观测性工作提前到开发阶段
vocabulary.example: Teams are shifting observability left so developers can identify issues earlier.

vocabulary.meaning: 吞吐量，单位时间内系统处理的请求或任务数量
vocabulary.example: Higher throughput can help an inference service handle more requests.

vocabulary.meaning: 能效高的，使用更少能源完成相同或更多计算任务的
vocabulary.example: The new chip is designed to provide faster and more power-efficient inference.
